properties.title: Creation
properties.description: Convert your bodies internal lipids into real world objects. The only limits are your understanding of the world.

properties.title: Open Creation Menu
properties.description: Opens your notebook to manage all of your known recipes, quick slots, and lipid count

properties.title: Default Lipid Capacity
properties.description: Your body can store up to 1000 lipids.

properties.title: Lipid Capacity - I
properties.description: Your body can now store up to 1500 lipids.

properties.title: Lipid Capacity - II
properties.description: Your body can now store up to 2000 lipids.

properties.title: Lipid Capacity - III
properties.description: Your body can now store up to 3000 lipids.

properties.title: Lipid Capacity - IV
properties.description: Your body can now store up to 5000 lipids.

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - I
properties.description: Unlocks the ability to study different armor compositions.

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - II
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to create copper based armor. (copper)

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - III
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to create iron based armor. (gold)

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - IV
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to create gold based armor. (iron)

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - V
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to create diamond based armor. (diamond)

properties.title: Armor Knowledge - VI
properties.description: You have the power to create any set of armor, but at great cost to your body.

properties.title: Basic Chemical Knowledge
properties.description: Unlocks the ability to research chemical elements, including potions. Basic potions only that are drinkable. No splash or lingering. NO POTIONS THAT REQUIRE MORE THAN 1 CRAFTING STEP!

properties.title: Adv. Chemical Knowledge
properties.description: Further increases your alchemical prowess, to unlock more complex potions. UNLOCKS COMPLICATED POTION STEPS, i.e potions that take more than 1 time in the brewing stand.

properties.title: Field Chemistry
properties.description: When a potion effect is applied to you, there is a chance you gain research progress for that effect.

properties.title: Chemical Knowledge - Splash
properties.description: User can now (without relearning) create the splash variants of potions.

properties.title: Chemical Knowledge - Lingering
properties.description: User can now (without relearning) create the lingering variants of potions.

properties.title: Chemical Knowledge - Timings
properties.description: Master the knowledge for understanding chemical timings. UNLOCKS THE ABILITY TO SET CUSTOM TIMES FOR THE POTIONS.

properties.title: Chemical Knowledge - Potency
properties.description: Master the knowledge for understanding chemical potency. UNLOCKS THE ABILITY TO CHANGE AMPLIFIER OF POTION TO +1 of VANILLA!

properties.title: Advanced Fletching Knowledge
properties.description: You are now able to research stronger mechanisms for shooting arrows, primarily crossbows.

properties.title: Tipped Arrows Knowledge
properties.description: Combining your knowledge of potions with the creation of arrows allows you to tip those arrows with different chemical effects.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - I
properties.description: Unlocks Unbreaking, Protection, Sharpness, Efficiency, Power, and Feather Falling for research.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - II
properties.description: Unlocks Knockback, Punch, Fire Protection, Projectile Protection, Fire Aspect, and Flame for research.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - III
properties.description: Unlocks Fortune, Looting, Respiration, Aqua Affinity, Depth Strider, and Quick Charge for research.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - IV
properties.description: Unlocks Silk Touch, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Blast Protection, Sweeping Edge, and Impaling for research.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - V
properties.description: Unlocks Thorns, Piercing, Multishot, Loyalty, Infinity, and Luck of the Sea for research.

properties.title: Enchant Knowledge - VI
properties.description: Unlocks Channeling, Riptide, Density, Breach, and Lure for research.

properties.title: Master Enchant Knowledge
properties.description: Unlocks Mending, Frost Walker, Soul Speed, Swift Sneak, and Wind Burst for research.

properties.title: Conflicting Enchant Knowledge
properties.description: You can apply enchantments that normally cannot coexist, such as Protection and Blast Protection. Enchantments that conflict with another selected enchantment cost twice as many lipids.

properties.title: Enchant Evolution
properties.description: When you create an enchanted item, each selected enchantment has a chance to apply one level higher than chosen for free. There is also a rare chance that every enchantment evolves, and the item's name becomes rainbow.

properties.title: Master Chemical Knowledge
properties.description: You are now able to create potion effects with +1 higher amplifier than normal minecraft

properties.title: Masonry Knowledge - I
properties.description: Gives your body the ability to create simple stone blocks, including sand.

properties.title: Masonry Knowledge - II
properties.description: Gives your body the ability to create more advanced stone blocks, glass, terracotta, concrete, sandstone, and prismarine.

properties.title: Masonry Knowledge - III
properties.description: Gives your body the ability to create non-block shapes: stairs, slabs, and walls for stone families.

description.unlocked: Gives your body the ability to create logs of any type, including bamboo blocks.

properties.title: Woodworking Knowledge - II
properties.description: Gives your body the ability to create more advanced wood of any type. (Planks, stripped, mosaic, etc.)

properties.title: Woodworking Knowledge - III
properties.description: Learn wood shapes: stairs, slabs, fences, doors, and fence gates. Any wood you have researched can be used.

properties.title: Woodworking Knowledge - IV
properties.description: Learn carpentry: signs, shelves, storage, boats, scaffolding, and workstations.

properties.title: Basic Material Creation
properties.description: Currently, your body is only able to create the most basic of minecraft materials. (stick, dirt, and cobblestone)

properties.title: Nether Knowledge - I
properties.description: You body is now able to learn the composition of materials based in the nether. (Netherack, nether wood, etc.)

properties.title: Nether Knowledge - III
properties.description: You can better shape nether blocks: nether brick, blackstone, and quartz stairs, slabs, and walls.

properties.title: Nether Knowledge - II
properties.description: You are now able to create more complicated blocks, like nether bricks, blackstone, quartz, and glowstone.

properties.title: Tailoring Knowledge - I
properties.description: Begin to understand the basics of synthetic wools, beds, and candles.

properties.title: Tailoring Knowledge - II
properties.description: You can now create fabrics directly, useful for creating super suits.

properties.title: Dye Knowledge
properties.description: Unlocks the ability to apply dyes to any available recipes automatically.

properties.title: Efficient Creation - I
properties.description: Your body is able to convert lipids at a more efficient rate. 1.2x

properties.title: Efficient Creation - II
properties.description: Your lipid conversion rate becomes even more efficient. 1.45x

properties.title: Efficient Creation - III
properties.description: Your lipid conversion rate becomes even more efficient. 1.7x

properties.title: Efficient Creation - IV
properties.description: You have reached the max lipid conversion rate your body can handle. 2x

properties.title: Knowledge Boost
properties.description: Maxing out your enchantment knowledge has unlocked a bonus to learning points. +25% Chance for double learn points

properties.title: Knowledge Boost
properties.description: Maxing out your masonry knowledge has unlocked a bonus to learning points. +25% Chance for double learn points

properties.title: Basic Fletching Knowledge
properties.description: You are now capable of learning simple ranged weapons like the bow and arrow.

properties.title: Item Knowledge - I
properties.description: You are able to understand the most basic of materials, plus clay and torches.

properties.title: Geology knowledge - I
properties.description: You are able to obtain knowledge of basic minerals found in the world. (copper, coal)

properties.title: Tooling Knowledge - I
properties.description: You can obtain the knowledge required to create copper-level tools, plus fishing rods.

properties.title: Geology knowledge - II
properties.description: You are able to obtain knowledge of rare minerals found in the world. (Iron, lead, redstone)

properties.title: Tooling Knowledge - II
properties.description: You can obtain the knowledge required to create gold-level tools.

properties.title: Tooling Knowledge - III
properties.description: You can obtain the knowledge required to create iron-level tools, plus shears.

properties.title: Geology knowledge - III
properties.description: You are able to obtain knowledge of slightly more rare minerals found in the world. (Gold, Lapis)

properties.title: Geology knowledge - IV
properties.description: You are able to obtain knowledge of precious minerals found in the world. (Diamond, Emeralds)

properties.title: Tooling Knowledge - IV
properties.description: You can obtain the knowledge required to create diamond-level tools.

properties.title: Geology knowledge - V
properties.description: You are able to obtain knowledge of extremely rare minerals found in the world. (Netherite, Vibranium)

properties.title: Tooling Knowledge - V
properties.description: You can obtain the knowledge required to create netherite-level tools.

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - I
properties.description: Gain the starting knowledge of weapons.

properties.title: Quick Craft - I
properties.description: Adds a quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recal it.

properties.title: Quick Craft - II
properties.description: Adds a secondary quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recall it.

properties.title: Quick Craft - III
properties.description: Adds a third quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recall it.

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - II
properties.description: Gain the knowledge to make stronger weapons. (copper)

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - III
properties.description: Gain the knowledge to make stronger weapons. (gold)

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - IV
properties.description: Gain the knowledge to make stronger weapons. (iron)

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - V
properties.description: Gain the knowledge to make stronger weapons. (diamond)

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - VI
properties.description: Gain the knowledge to make stronger weapons. (netherite)

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - Spears
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to make spears.

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - Mace
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to make maces..

properties.title: Weapon Knowledge - Sheilds
properties.description: Unlocks the knowledge required to make shields.

properties.title: End Knowledge
properties.description: You can now analyze items from the End: end stone, purpur, and ender pearls.

properties.title: Technologist Knowledge - I
properties.description: Learn to fabricate grenades and flashbangs from canisters and common explosives.

properties.title: Quick Craft - IV
properties.description: Adds a fourth quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recall it.

properties.title: Quick Craft - V
properties.description: Adds a fifth quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recall it.

properties.title: Quick Craft - VI
properties.description: Adds a sixth quick craft slot that allows you to save an item and quickly recall it.

properties.title: Item Knowledge - II
properties.description: You can further understand slightly more complex items, including slime, prismarine shards, fireworks, and echo shards.

properties.title: Item Knowledge - III
properties.description: Learn manufactured utilities: buckets, bundles, lighting, rails, minecarts, saddles, and similar tools.

properties.title: Redstone Knowledge
properties.description: You are able to understand the complexities of redstone design. Unlocks numerous redstone components.

properties.title: Circuit Knowledge
properties.description: Circuitry is something you can get your hands on.
